finding: Independent enumeration agreement is insufficient unless the complete raw-to-promotion evidence set is retained, byte-bound, role-complete, and bound to one exact commit.
design_implication: Require a seven-role retention manifest covering both raw enumerations, the independent command, both normalized envelopes, reconciliation result, and promotion assessment before evidence promotion.

verification.environment: isolated Node runtime against the exact committed source text before publication
cases: same-length retained artifact mutation rejected by SHA-256

uncertainty: The verifier has not yet been run on a real authenticated exact-commit evidence set.
falsification_route: Construct a complete retained evidence set from both authenticated enumeration clients, mutate or omit each role in turn, and confirm fail-closed results before promotion.
privacy_boundary: No credentials, private workflow payloads, or deployment secrets are included.
